dedupe_keys.name: v2sim open source microscopic vehicle to grid simulation platform for coupled urban power and transport networks

description: V2Sim is an open-source Python platform for vehicle-to-grid analysis that couples a microscopic urban transport network simulated in SUMO with a power distribution network solved by an optimised DistFlow model. It models electric vehicle trips, route planning and charging decisions at fast and slow charging stations, V2G dispatch strategies, perception of charging station faults and charging prices, and can run many cases in parallel to generate data. Researchers from Southeast University, Xi'an Jiaotong University and the charging firm Star Charge released it with an arXiv preprint in December 2024. Coverage: demonstrated on a 37-junction test case and a real-world Nanjing network. Format and access: Python code on GitHub. Licence: BSD 3-Clause as stated in the paper; free. Caveats: it is a research platform, and results depend on SUMO scenario and behaviour assumptions. It supports studies of how charging station faults and EV behaviour propagate between transport and power networks. Related catalogue records are SUMO and the SMART-DS synthetic distribution network models.
